units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:6">Makhsh. V, 6</cite> <he>החובט על הש׳</he> he who beats upon a (wetted) hide.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:4">Bekh. IX, 4</cite> <he>נשחטה … והש׳ קיים</he> when its mother has been killed, but the hide is still intact.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:1">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:1">IX</cite>), 1; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁלָחִין</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 4:2">Sabb. IV, 2</cite> <he>טומנין בש׳</he> you may keep dishes warm (for the Sabbath) in fresh hides. Ib. 49ᵃ <he>ש׳ של בעה״ב</he> hides belonging to a private man; <he>של אומן</he> to a mechanic (shoemaker &c.). Ib.ᵇ <he>הביאו ש׳ וכ׳</he> bring us hides to sit down on them; a. e.
